task: Classify immune infiltration level in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. Classes: low, medium, and high immune class. Relevant H&E features include the amount of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, stromal inflammatory cells, and the balance between desmoplastic stroma and active immune infiltrates.

classes.0: Low immune class with markedly sparse lymphocytes in a predominantly desmoplastic tumor stroma.
classes.1: Medium immune class with an intermediate inflammatory infiltrate scattered through tumor and stroma.
classes.2: High immune class with conspicuous lymphocytic infiltration within tumor and surrounding stroma despite desmoplasia.
